# BigSavingsDays

> The high-converting deal, coupon, and affiliate link platform.

BigSavingsDays (https://bigsavingsdays.com) is a modern link management and deal syndication platform built for affiliate marketers, Telegram deal channels, WhatsApp shopping groups, creators, and online stores.

Unlike generic link shorteners that are frequently flagged as suspicious or spam, links generated on BigSavingsDays signal instant discounts, verified savings, and maximum conversion rates.

## Core Capabilities
- **Deal Link Shortener**: Converts long affiliate URLs (Amazon, Flipkart, Walmart, AliExpress, Shopify) into clean, high-trust short links.
- **Deals Hub (Bio Storefronts)**: Mobile-first deal showcase pages (e.g. `/p/topdeals`) with discount badges ("70% OFF"), 1-click coupon code copy buttons, and direct purchase CTAs.
- **Auto-Affiliate & UTM Injection**: Automatically preserves and injects associate tags and campaign UTM parameters.
- **Deal Safeguards & Fallbacks**: Configurable expiration fallback redirects so traffic is never sent to dead or full-price listings when a flash sale ends.
- **Real-Time Click Analytics**: Granular tracking across referral channels (Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, YouTube, Direct), devices, and geolocations.
- **Developer API**: REST API v1 supporting link creation, stats retrieval, and programmatic syndication.
